_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'blank' (site 2): a UI localization package is files under App_Plugins plus a manifest, not C# registered into DI, and the starter-kit-free host is the one whose backoffice text nothing else has localized. namespace is unused by these assets (JSON and JS only) but every manifest declares one. <PackageName> is the App_Plugins folder the wiring writes to, and it appears in the manifest's js paths, so the two must agree.
